faq_heading: Questions people ask about GEO services

faqs.q: What are generative engine optimization services?
faqs.a: They are services that make your business easier for AI assistants and AI search features to find, understand and cite. That means answer-first content, clean indexing, trusted mentions and regular checks of what AI tools say about you.

They overlap a lot. Google says the same SEO basics apply to its AI features, and a page must be indexed to appear as a supporting link. GEO adds a focus on direct answers, brand mentions and tracking AI answers.

faqs.q: Can a GEO service guarantee that ChatGPT will mention my company?
faqs.a: No. OpenAI says no site is promised a place in ChatGPT search results. Treat any guarantee as a warning sign and ask for a plan and regular reporting instead.

faqs.q: How do I measure whether a GEO service is working?
faqs.a: Keep a fixed list of buyer questions, ask them in the main AI assistants each week, and note whether your company is named and linked. Track Search Console clicks and enquiries alongside.

faqs.q: How long do GEO results take?
faqs.a: Plan in weeks to months. Pages must be published, indexed and trusted before AI tools cite them, so early signs are usually more impressions and brand mentions rather than leads.
